source.classifier: community GadgetExcel Chest type; historical resource only

limits: This is a static historical AstaPS server resource snapshot; source pinning does not authenticate official Global 7.1 scene placements.
Chest-type filtering derives from public-copy GadgetExcel for exact comparability with the previous historical 14,084-instance census; it does not use native original Gadget semantics.
Only directly assigned numeric gadget.level is counted; nested fields, strings and comments do not alter it.
All 2,683 missing direct level assignments fall within the no-metadata group (no chest_drop_id and no drop_tag). This does not establish whether these objects should receive rewards.
Scene script integer levels are predominantly 1, 6, 11, 16, 21, 26 and can reach 92. No observed value is proven to equal chest common/exquisite/precious/luxurious grade.
Java source gives an unset int level default of zero; any downstream reward matching effect still depends on the actual server selection and reward path.
No original official server reward amount, probability, chest grade, client scene instance or original level owner is proven.
